title: The bestiary's stage slow and far: on the stage only, the bodies hop on a longer cycle at a slower walk and stretch their stalks about twice as far before they move, the lure slower and further off than the full stalk, the view wider
context: Owner, 2026-10-14, after looking at the bestiary: 'bestiary; still unsatisfactory with how we represent the enemy locomotion, the appendage extend a tiny bit, instead of the ominous slow feeling around, everything is too rushed. we need; slower animation; longer reach, wider view - they have to reach further to catch the prey.' On the stage only; the game's bodies keep their pace. Branch bestiary-feel, cut from main at b354fdd1 (the bestiary and the swarm lab merged, the tiers named Cutis-Soft / Cutis-Core, the stage enlarged to a 54 m disc).
outcome: src/fx/bestiary-stage.js makes its family from its own copies of the game's tables, changed by BESTIARY_STAGE.body's named multipliers in src/content/bestiary.js (the owner tunes them there): cycle x4 (every tier's hop cycle; the Cutis-Maku's too), reach x1.8 (the stride, PEARL_GAIT.hop 2.4 -> 4.32 body radii), speed x0.6 (the record's walk), lead x2 (PEARL_FOLLOW.leadHops 0.6 -> 1.2 of a hop), and timing coil .08, extend .40, anchor .04, transfer .36, settle .12 (the game's .10/.22/.03/.52/.13): a long, deliberate extend, then the body pouring along the stalk. The lure: its mean speed 0.9 of the pack's walk (lure.pace; its period follows), its boost x speed (2.5 -> 1.5), and it keeps 1.15 of the pack's full stalk from every body (lure.aheadReach; 11.1 m for the white pack, 16.7 m for the brown). The view: the disc 54 -> 84 m, the loop 24 -> 36 m, the pack seated 13 -> 34 m behind the lure's start (outside the lure's bolt, twice its lead, so it closes first), the orbit 52 -> 76 m at 32 -> 50 m up, a turn in 140 s, the camera's focus 0.4 of the way to the lure, snapped onto the pack when it is seated. Measured in node, a pack of three for 20 s against the same stage at the game's numbers (test/bestiary-stage.mjs): stalk a hop, in body lengths, white 1.00 -> 2.10, yellow 0.98 -> 2.10, blue 0.87 -> 1.69, orange 0.87 -> 1.71, green 0.84 -> 1.66, purple 0.84 -> 1.70, brown 0.83 -> 1.73, black 0.71 -> 1.63; hops 17-29 -> 5-8; time extending 4.5-4.7 -> 8.1-8.4 s; a hop takes 7-10 s, 40 per cent of it extending; no record ever within the lure's lead; the white pack closes from 34 m to about 23 m over some 40 s before the lure bolts. In the browser the reach screenshot at the end of an extend shows each white body's stalk about two body lengths out, drawn whole with its cup (the kit's own reach is 15 radii, so 4.3 is well inside what its hull draws).
alternatives: The cycle as a plain slowdown (x2): the kit's pace only ever shortens a hop (pearlPace at most 1), so a body's hop takes its stride over its walk once the cycle is long enough; at x2 the faster-cycling tiers outran their records and their stalks were cut short (the black tier stretched 0.8 of a body length a hop). Taken at x4 as a ceiling, so the walk and the stride set the cadence.

A longer reach without a farther hunt point: the kit caps a stalk at the distance to the point the body hunts (swarm.js plan()), and that point is the record's plus 0.6 of a hop, so the reach multiplier alone did not show; the lead x2 puts the point a full stride ahead.

The lure's period divided by the walk's multiplier (the brief's first idea): at the 36 m loop the lure still ran 2.4 m/s against the pack's 1 m/s and lapped it; its mean speed is now a share of the pack's own walk.
Seating the pack 20 m back: inside the lure's bolt (twice its lead), so the lure fled at once and the pack never closed; 34 m.

Changing the kit or the game's tables: not needed; the family already takes its tier set, gait and follow tables as parameters. The one change outside the bestiary's files is creature-pearl.js view() reporting the hop's phase and stalk length, read only.
evidence: node test/bestiary-stage.mjs (the table above), node test/bestiary.mjs

STALHEART_BROWSER_PORT=18162 node scripts/browser-test.mjs --bestiary: PASS bestiary-unseen, -white, -white-reach (a stalk past a body length, the lure 11.13 m ahead of a 9.68 m stalk), -orange, -console, -silhouette, -lab
